titleEn: Minimum Cost to Change the Final Value of Expression
title: 反转表达式值的最少操作次数
summary: 布尔表达式含零、一、与、或和括号，每次可翻转一个数字或运算符，求让最终值反转的最少操作次数。
insight: 每个子表达式维护变成 0 和 1 的最小代价。合并左右状态时枚举左右目标值和当前/翻转后的运算符；递归下降处理括号，并按题目规则从左到右合并同层运算。
pitfalls: 与和或在本题同优先级并从左向右

solutions.title: 递归解析二值代价 DP
solutions.idea: 解析时为每个子式计算两个目标布尔值的最低修改代价。
steps: combine 枚举左右值与 &/|，加上运算符是否翻转的代价
递归解析括号并同层左结合；返回原值相反下标的代价

code.java: class Solution { private String expression;private int position;private int[] combine(int[] left,int[] right,char operator){int[] result={1_000_000,1_000_000};for(int a=0;a<2;a++)for(int b=0;b<2;b++)for(char used:new char[]{'&','|'}){int value=used=='&'?(a&b):(a|b);result[value]=Math.min(result[value],left[a]+right[b]+(used==operator?0:1));}return result;}private int[] atom(){char current=expression.charAt(position);if(current=='('){position++;int[] value=parse();position++;return value;}position++;return current=='0'?new int[]{0,1}:new int[]{1,0};}private int[] parse(){int[] value=atom();while(position<expression.length()&&expression.charAt(position)!=')'){char operator=expression.charAt(position++);value=combine(value,atom(),operator);}return value;}public int minOperationsToFlip(String expression){this.expression=expression;position=0;int[] cost=parse();return cost[0]==0?cost[1]:cost[0];} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { private lateinit var expression:String;private var position=0;private fun combine(left:IntArray,right:IntArray,operator:Char):IntArray{val result=intArrayOf(1_000_000,1_000_000);for(a in 0..1)for(b in 0..1)for(used in charArrayOf('&','|')){val value=if(used=='&')a and b else a or b;result[value]=minOf(result[value],left[a]+right[b]+if(used==operator)0 else 1)};return result};private fun atom():IntArray{val current=expression[position];if(current=='('){position++;val value=parse();position++;return value};position++;return if(current=='0')intArrayOf(0,1) else intArrayOf(1,0)};private fun parse():IntArray{var value=atom();while(position<expression.length&&expression[position]!=')'){val operator=expression[position++];value=combine(value,atom(),operator)};return value};fun minOperationsToFlip(expression:String):Int{this.expression=expression;position=0;val cost=parse();return if(cost[0]==0)cost[1] else cost[0]} }
code.cpp: class Solution { string expression;int position=0;array<int,2> combine(array<int,2> left,array<int,2> right,char op){array<int,2> result={1000000,1000000};for(int a=0;a<2;++a)for(int b=0;b<2;++b)for(char used:string("&|")){int value=used=='&'?(a&b):(a|b);result[value]=min(result[value],left[a]+right[b]+(used==op?0:1));}return result;}array<int,2> atom(){char current=expression[position];if(current=='('){++position;auto value=parse();++position;return value;}++position;return current=='0'?array<int,2>{0,1}:array<int,2>{1,0};}array<int,2> parse(){auto value=atom();while(position<(int)expression.size()&&expression[position]!=')'){char op=expression[position++];value=combine(value,atom(),op);}return value;}public: int minOperationsToFlip(string input){expression=input;position=0;auto cost=parse();return cost[0]==0?cost[1]:cost[0];} };
